# First-order diffraction efficiency of FURST grating ID01, simulated by Zeiss
# (FURST FUV Grating final report, C. Stock, 14 July 2023, page 69,
# "ID01: center position - coated profiles"). Rigorous calculation of the
# sinusoidal profile measured by AFM at the center of the grating after coating,
# 38.5 nm peak to valley, 2200 lines/mm, coated with aluminum and a
# protective layer of magnesium fluoride. The efficiency includes the reflectance
# of that coating and is the mean of the TE and TM polarizations.
# Digitized from the plotted curves (381x286 pixel images in the report; one pixel
# is about 0.26 nm by 0.07 percentage points) and resampled onto a 0.5 nm grid.
# wavelength (nm), 10.50 deg (%), 14.25 deg (%), 18.00 deg (%)
